fullPassage: Spending time as children allows animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must rely more fully on hardware, and therefore be less flexible. Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don’t adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.

Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don’t adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 hardware가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hardware = 학습이 아니라 태어날 때부터 주어진 '본능(선천적 프로그램)'을 비유
det.analysis:
❌ ① 부모에게서 배우는 이동 기술: 이는 학습(문화)에 해당하며 hardware와 반대
✅ ② 타고난 본능(선천적으로 주어진 프로그램): 유년기(학습)가 없으면 더 의존하게 되는 'hardware'는 태어날 때 주어진 본능을 비유함 ←정답
❌ ③ 환경 변화에 대한 빠른 적응 능력: 본능에 의존하면 오히려 적응이 어렵다고 했으므로 반대
❌ ④ 문화적으로 전달되는 정보: 이는 학습(유전자보다 빠른 문화)이라 hardware와 대비됨
det.tip: rely more fully on hardware — 학습 대신 타고난 본능에 의존

ch: 환경 변화에 대한 빠른 적응 능력

[조건] (1) can, culture, evolve, faster, genes, than 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '문화는 유전자보다 더 빠르게 진화할 수 있다' = culture can evolve faster than genes
det.analysis: 주어 culture(문화) + 조동사 can + 동사원형 evolve(진화하다). '더 빠르게'는 비교급 faster로 쓰고, 비교 대상은 than genes(유전자보다)로 붙입니다. 순서: culture → can → evolve → faster → than → genes.
det.tip: 비교급 + than: faster than genes = 유전자보다 더 빠르게

questions.wa: culture can evolve faster than genes
accept: culture can evolve faster than genes

questions.passage: Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate sometimes have very inefficient __________ (migrate) routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don’t adapt easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(migrate)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: very inefficient __(migrate) routes → 명사 routes를 앞에서 꾸미는 명사 자리이므로 동사 migrate를 명사 migration으로 변형.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 명사 routes(경로)를 앞에서 꾸미는 자리로, '이동 경로'라는 복합명사가 필요해요. 동사 migrate(이동하다)를 명사 migration(이동)으로 바꿔야 'migration routes(이동 경로)'가 됩니다. 그래서 정답은 migration.
det.tip: 동사 → 명사: migrate → migration. migration routes(이동 경로)
